notice: Zero-tools profile after load-state qualification and the 2026-08-16 isolation preflight. Re-verify host, model, reasoning controls, discovery, permissions, isolation, and availability immediately before every proof run. An unavailable lane cannot support the zero-tools portability claim.

qualification_notes: Cursor print mode exposes write and shell tools and has no observable empty-tool-set control.

load_state_observation.method: Pair Cursor's interactive /skills inventory with complete stream-json traces from fresh sessions.
load_state_observation.positive_signal: The /skills inventory lists create-agent-skill and the positive stream records a readToolCall for the exact SKILL.md path before task execution.
load_state_observation.negative_signal: The /skills inventory lists create-agent-skill and the complete near-miss stream reaches success without any readToolCall for that path.

qualification_notes: Antigravity plan mode has no tool-list or empty-tool option.

load_state_observation.method: Pair Antigravity's structured /skills command_result with complete stream-json traces from fresh sessions.
load_state_observation.positive_signal: The /skills result lists create-agent-skill as model-invocable and the positive stream records view_file for the exact SKILL.md path before task execution.
load_state_observation.negative_signal: The /skills result lists create-agent-skill as model-invocable and the complete near-miss stream reaches SUCCESS without any view_file for that path.

qualification_notes: Codex read-only sandboxing still permits tool-based reads and has no observable empty-tool-set contract.

load_state_observation.method: Pair Codex debug prompt-input discovery output with complete codex exec --json traces from fresh sessions.
load_state_observation.positive_signal: The prompt-input output lists the exact SKILL.md locator and the positive trace records a command_execution that reads that path before task execution.
load_state_observation.negative_signal: The prompt-input output lists the exact SKILL.md locator and the complete near-miss trace reaches turn.completed without any command_execution for that path.

load_state_observation.method: Pair Claude Code's startup debug/init inventory with complete stream-json traces from fresh sessions.

load_state_observation.negative_signal: Startup debug names the project skill root, init lists create-agent-skill, and the complete near-miss stream reaches success without any Skill(create-agent-skill) event.
